versions.content: Event chains Type: valid Description: The AUTOSAR templates shall provide the means to describe timing specific event chains. An event chain is used as the subject to attach a timing constraint. It describes the temporal correlation between two observable events, referred to as stimulus and response, that have a functional dependency. Rationale: Event chains are an essential prerequisite to define the scope and semantics of timing constraints. Use Case: Analysis and validation of timing behavior 5 13 of 34  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 410: AUTOSAR_RS_TimingExtensions Requirements on Timing Extensions AUTOSAR CP R19-11 4 Dependencies: None identified. Supporting Material: None
